name: driving
title: Self-driving car
notes: Imitates a rule-based expert driver over 60,000 sampled situations.

inputs.label: fast
inputs.description: The car's speed, as a share of 72 km/h.

inputs.label: red light
inputs.description: The next traffic light ahead is red.

inputs.label: yellow light
inputs.description: The next traffic light ahead is yellow.

inputs.label: green light
inputs.description: The next traffic light ahead is green.

inputs.label: near the light
inputs.description: How close the next stop line is; 0 if none.

inputs.label: pedestrian on crosswalk
inputs.description: Someone is on the crosswalk ahead.

inputs.label: pedestrian at curb
inputs.description: Someone is waiting to cross ahead.

inputs.label: near the crosswalk
inputs.description: How close the next crosswalk is; 0 if none.

inputs.label: car ahead
inputs.description: A car is ahead in this lane.

inputs.label: close behind a car
inputs.description: How close the car ahead is; 0 if none.

inputs.label: closing on car ahead
inputs.description: How fast the gap is shrinking.

inputs.label: rain
inputs.description: The road is wet: drive slower, stop earlier.

inputs.label: night
inputs.description: It is dark. The expert ignores this; a good policy should too.
